# Wulandari BCAA: identity, denominators and access limits

**Wulandari BCAA: kimlik, paydalar ve erişim sınırları**  
**Selected review: 26 October 2026.** Existing record `wulandari-icu-bcaa-print-2026`; DOI [10.1016/j.clnesp.2025.11.153](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.clnesp.2025.11.153). Online 29 November 2025; April 2026 issue. This updates one existing small two-centre report, not a new large multicentre trial or completed systematic appraisal.

## What was actually read

Original access on 24 October was publisher-indexed Methods/Results, with a direct request returning 403. A later indexed original registration statement identifies **NCT06167772**. On 26 October the [official current API](https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT06167772) was directly retrieved and archived locally. The matching DOI appears as a derived registry reference; this alone is not an overlap crosswalk or sponsor-confirmed final analysis plan.

A fresh normal VETİS → ScienceDirect request recognized institutional access and returned one exact-DOI result. Article navigation was rejected by browser security policy. No workaround or new login was attempted. **Full original main text, flow image, supplement, dated protocol/SAP and archived registry versions remain unread.** The [study-page link](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06167772) is a navigation aid, not a claim that its history was reviewed.

## Separate the quantities and source labels

| Item | Verified access level and remaining boundary |
|---|---|
| 40 analyzed; muscle N36; reported 33% loss | Retained partial original descriptions. Randomized/allocated N, arm/time denominators and reasons/timing of losses are not established. Do not reverse-calculate from a rounded percentage. |
| Current actual enrollment 40 | Official registry field; it does not define the article's randomized or analyzed population. These quantities are not additive. |
| Public posting 13 December 2023; recorded start 14 December | Current chronology only. Earliest public outcome wording and final-analysis prespecification remain unverified. |
| Article double-blind; registry quadruple | Labels do not establish the masking procedure. Registry categorizes a placebo comparator while describing no placebo. |
| Current outcome classification | Muscle thickness primary, IL-6 secondary and SOFA other, at ten days. No results or flow section was returned. |

Both groups received standard nutrition and NMES; reported achieved protein/energy differed. The randomized nutritional strategy cannot establish an isolated leucine effect. Registry gram descriptions do not repair the retained article mg/g inconsistency. Its nitrogen-versus-protein/nonprotein-calorie wording also differs internally. No composition normalization or executable regimen is inferred.

The registry acronym “SOFA” is a trial label, not evidence that an organ score measures inflammation or selects a nutrition dose. Clinical interpretation and independent validation remain separate. See [clinical methods](./CLINICAL-MODULES-METHODS.md), [component evidence](./LEUCINE-BCAA-HMB-EVIDENCE-NOTE.md) and the [reference-feasibility worksheet](./REFERENCE-FEASIBILITY-DECISION-RECORD.md).

Current registry eligibility excludes neuromuscular disease **with right quadriceps femoris paralysis**, rather than all neuromuscular disease. This source-qualified correction does not establish the actual final neurological case mix or become an application eligibility gate.

**Türkçe:** Güncel resmî kayıt doğrudan okundu; özgün makalenin tamamı veya hasta akışı okunmuş sayılmaz. Kayıttaki 40 katılım, yayındaki 40 analiz ve kas için 36 gözlem ayrı kaynaklıdır; randomizasyon sayısı kayıp yüzdesinden hesaplanmaz. Çift/dört kör etiketleri ve plasebosuz kontrol açıklaması körleme yöntemini açıklamaz. Ortak NMES, farklı protein/enerji ve mg/g uyuşmazlığı saf lösin yararı veya doz üretmez. Kayıt tarihi katılımdan önce görünse de ilk sürüm/SAP doğrulanmadı. Bu belge teknik kaynak izidir; biçimsel yanlılık puanı değildir.
